messages:
maya: Heads up — CI turned red on runtime::timewarp_unit_test on linux-k8s-parallel. Fails intermittently with 'deadline exceeded waiting for timer'. Happening ~1/8 runs. Anyone seen this?
CI Bot: [build #4821] job failed: https://ci.redwood/4821 — failing test: runtime::timewarp_unit_test
CI Bot: log excerpt:
```
--- FAIL: timewarp_unit_test (0.53s)
    timer_test.go:87: expected tick before timeout, got deadline exceeded
```
anita: I bumped into something like this last week when running with heavy concurrent clients. Could be mocked clock + shared scheduler timing.
tomas: Repro locally for you yet, @maya? If you can get a local flake we can bisect. Also share GOMAXPROCS and docker image tag.
maya: Not reproducible locally on my M1. Repro only on CI agent (linux container). GOMAXPROCS=8, image: redwood/runtime-test:2026-03-15. I added the raw CI log to the run.
ryan: Quick ask — can we rerun the job with GO_TEST_NODE=1 and -run TestTimewarp/tight_loop to reduce noise? Might surface a race. Also try setting -test.count=10 locally.
maya: Good idea. I'll queue a rerun with extra flags. Command I used:
```
go test ./runtime -run TestTimewarp -v -test.run TestTimewarp/tight_loop -test.count=50
```
CI Bot: Rerun queued as build #4822 by @maya. Link: https://ci.redwood/4822
tomas: If it flakes again, can we collect pprof + trace and enable extra logging around timer expiry path? Adding a small sleep jitter in the test might make it less flaky but we want root cause.
anita: I can add a temporary non-merge change that logs the timer state and increments a counter so we can correlate which goroutine lost the wakeup. Will push a branch and request a short canary run.
ryan: Also consider adding an env flag to force using monotonic clock only (if code switches between system and mocked time). Sometimes linux kernel vs container clocks cause weird drifts.
maya: Thanks — branch opened: maya/timewarp-flake-log. Ran build #4822 — still failing on one worker, same assertion. Captured trace and uploaded to the build artifacts. Link: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/4822/timewarp.trace
tomas: Got the trace — looks like a goroutine stuck waiting on select for ~200ms while timer popped earlier; possibility of missed signal when scheduler was overloaded. Can we run with GOMAXPROCS=4 to see if it reduces frequency?
anita: I'll push a patch that adds a tiny backoff/notify retry in the test to make the assertion more robust while we bisect. Putting it behind TEST_FLAKY_FIX guard.
maya: Thanks all. Plan: (1) bisect on master to find first breakage, (2) collect more traces for flaky failures, (3) provisional test guard on CI to reduce noise. Ping me if you want to join bisect run. :thumbsup:
